name: A live inline claimant cannot keep the worker running beyond its delivery budget
Inline harvest acknowledges published findings and suppresses their notification
Failed publication retains readable findings and timings; later startup publishes and notifies once
A held publication lock ends the reserved worker with retained actionable timeout findings
A held notification queue lock leaves bounded delivery recoverable at the next startup
A held nested recovery lock leaves bounded delivery recoverable at the next startup
An interrupted reservation leaves staged current-generation findings recoverable by later startup
A committed successor generation rejects stale staged findings without notification
A replaced owner cannot execute mutating sweeps or launch a locked startup
The unchanged captured owner runs deferred sweeps under the acquisition lease
A held acquisition lease ends the worker without executing sweeps and reports the refusal
Publication contention retains completed real probe findings and their matching timings for later recovery
A real primary sees an explicit fresh-check failure in its startup digest while unpublished findings remain retained
